## Place & Manner

### Place

- *Where* the point of greatest constriction is.

### Manner

- *What* happens at that place of constriction.

# Place

## Place

Most articulations have an *active* and a *passive* articulator

- Active: the articulator that moves

- Passive: the articulator that gets moved to

Most places of articulation and named for the location of the passive articulator.

## Place

There are also terms based on the active articulator involved.

- Front of tongue: Coronal

  - Tip of tongue: Apical

  - Blade of tongue: Laminal

- Back of tongue: Dorsal

## Place

|--------------|--------------|
| [ʂ, ʐ]{.ipa} | [ç, ʝ]{.ipa} |
| (retroflex)  | (palatal)    |

# Manner

## Manner

*What* happens at each place of articulatio.

## Manner

### Oral Stops/Plosives

- Full constriction between articulators

- No oral airflow

- No nasal airflow

## Manner

### Trills & Taps

- Trills

  - Articulators held loosely together, allowing for airflow to generate the Bernoulli effect

- Taps

  - A very fast, glancing articulation.

## "Rhotics"

Rhotics aren't a phonetically coherent set of sounds. Sounds classified as rhotics include

- alveolar trills

- uvular trills

- uvular fricatives

- velar fricatives

- alveolar taps

- retroflex approximants

- alveolar approximants

- whatever bunched [ɹ] is

## "Rhotics"

As the name would suggest, these are sounds spelled with characters derived from Greek "$\rho$".

  (function () {

    function fireSlideEnter() {

      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
